unsaved_work_reason: Every field saves to the server the moment it is inserted (trpc.field.signFieldWithToken in each document-signing-*-field.tsx, e.g. document-signing-signature-field.tsx:68,149; trpc.envelope.field.sign in envelope-signing-provider.tsx:141,333), so inserted fields survive a refresh. Lost on refresh or on a failed insert: a signature drawn/typed/uploaded in the pad but not yet inserted, text typed into an open field dialog, and the Full Name and Signature typed into the side panel, all of which live only in React state (document-signing-provider.tsx:48-52, document-signing-form.tsx:239-259). A logged-in recipient gets their account name/signature back from the loader (_index.tsx:472-473), an anonymous recipient does not. In the V2 renderer a failed insert also drops the drawn signature, because setSignature only runs after signField succeeds (envelope-signer-page-renderer.tsx:396-407), and the text dialog reopens empty (sign-field-text-dialog.tsx:35-38).

consequence_reason: A recipient who already has an account is told to Sign up and sent to the signup page, so they head down the wrong path, and refreshing shows the same wrong button.
evidence_add: document-signing-auth-page.tsx:27 routes to /signup#email= and :73 labels the button 'Sign up' whenever emailHasAccount is falsy; complete.tsx:146 passes only email. Account access auth means the recipient needed an account to sign in the first place, so on /complete the label is wrong for nearly everyone who sees it.

consequence_reason: The message is true and a browser refresh re-fetches the PDF on the same URL; inserted fields are already saved, so only an open dialog's unsaved entry is lost.
evidence_add: pdf-viewer-states.tsx:12-25 has no button, so 'try again' means a manual reload; fields persist per action (signFieldWithToken / envelope.field.sign), so reload loses nothing already inserted.

consequence_reason: Missing drag-and-drop costs nothing: the tap-to-pick upload button works with mouse, touch and keyboard.
A sender using the public API can turn off all three signature methods, and then the signature dialog crashes the page for every recipient on every retry, so nobody can sign.
gap_label: Extend [SignaturePad], move the all-disabled guard above the useState initializer; add server-side refine (at least one method true) to ZDocumentMetaCreateSchema and API v1 meta
evidence_add: The UI blocks it (signatureTypes .min(1) in add-settings.types.ts:35, envelope-editor-settings-dialog.tsx:110; team settings reject all-false at update-team-settings.ts:69), but the API does not: packages/api/v1/schema.ts:170-172 accepts three plain booleans passed straight through at implementation.ts:438-440, and ZDocumentMetaCreateSchema/UpdateSchema (packages/lib/types/document-meta.ts:113-139) have no cross-field check. signature-pad.tsx:82 throws 'No signature enabled' inside useState before the null guard at :134; SignaturePad mounts when the dialog opens (signature-pad-dialog.tsx:112-114) and the throw reaches root ErrorBoundary (root.tsx:207).

consequence_reason: On V2 envelopes the dialog lets you submit over-long text, then shows a generic 'error occurred while signing the field' toast and throws the text away, so the recipient retries the same thing without knowing it was too long.
gap_label: Reuse [validateTextField + 'N characters over' message from document-signing-text-field.tsx:106-116,296-305] in sign-field-text-dialog.tsx
evidence_add: V1 blocks it correctly: document-signing-text-field.tsx:106-116 validates before sending and :296-305 shows '(N characters over)'. V2 does not: sign-field-text-dialog.tsx:21-23 schema has no max, the counter at :72-77 just goes negative, text-field.ts:34-44 sends it, the server rejects via envelope-signing.ts:127-132 (with the wrong message 'Invalid email'), the renderer shows the generic toast at envelope-signer-page-renderer.tsx:527-531, and the dialog reopens empty (sign-field-text-dialog.tsx:35-38).

consequence_reason: The empty-results message shows and the recipient can clear the search; only non-English recipients see it in English, which does not stop them.
evidence_add: sign-field-dropdown-dialog.tsx:32 literal 'No results found.' not wrapped in Trans.

consequence_reason: When the code has expired the screen says 'Invalid verification code. Please try again.', so the recipient re-enters the same dead code instead of pressing Resend.
evidence_add: document-signing-complete-dialog.tsx:173-178 maps every TWO_FACTOR_AUTH_FAILED to 'Invalid verification code. Please try again.'; the server check validate-2fa-token-from-email.ts returns only true/false, so expiry and typos are indistinguishable. Resend exists (access-auth-2fa-form.tsx:111-121), so the path out is there but not pointed to.

consequence_reason: Offline, a failed insert or Complete shows a generic error toast that doesn't mention the connection, but everything already inserted is saved, and retrying once back online works; only the one signature or text entry being inserted has to be redone.
evidence_add: Status corrected from gap: error handling exists, just not connectivity-specific (envelope-signer-page-renderer.tsx:527-531 'An error occurred while signing the field.'). A failed V2 signature insert skips setSignature (:396-407) so the drawing must be redone; the text dialog reopens empty (sign-field-text-dialog.tsx:35-38). Earlier inserted fields persist server-side.

consequence_reason: A slow load only shows a spinner with no progress, but it finishes on its own and nothing is lost.
The toast correctly says the link expired or the document was cancelled, and a refresh lands on the matching end page; the only cost is the dead form left open behind the toast.
evidence_add: Toast copy is specific and true (toast-error-messages.ts:52-79); field data is not at stake because the document is closed server-side.

consequence_reason: On V2 envelopes the fields are drawn on a canvas that only responds to a pointer, so a keyboard-only recipient cannot insert any field at all and no refresh or retry changes that; on V1 the same happens for draw-only envelopes.
gap_label: Extend [V1 field overlay <button> pattern from document-signing-field-container.tsx:122-125] to V2: render a focusable, named DOM button over each Konva field that calls handleFieldGroupClick; keep a Type path for draw-only envelopes; Reuse [sr-only label on Remove button]

consequence_reason: A screen-reader user cannot find or identify fields: V2 fields are canvas shapes with nothing exposed to assistive tech, and V1 fields are unnamed buttons, and refreshing changes nothing.
